defs.def: a written or spoken piece of information, etc. that you send to sb or leave for sb when you cannot speak to them yourself （书面或口头的）信息，消息，音信

ex.s: When the final bell rang in June, I walked away with a yearbook full of messages about writing’s most powerful significance — the ability to connect people, to put us in another’s skin, to teach us what it means to be human.
ex.t: 当六月的下课铃响起，我带着一本写满留言的年鉴离开，那些话道出了写作最强大的意义——把人们连接起来、让我们设身处地、教会我们生而为人的含义。

ex.s: A couple of messages came in, one wanting additional ___46___, another asking for a price cut.
ex.t: 来了几条消息，一个想要更多___46___，另一个要求降价。

ex.s: Consider the best method to deliver your message.
ex.t: 旅游团每天下午1点整从水坝广场出发，每小时一班。

ex.s: The best messages are often simple.
ex.t: 最好的信息往往简洁明了。

ex.s: I jumped out of the car, made a mad run for the machine, and popped my card in, only to read the message: "Out of order.
ex.t: 我跳下车，拼命跑向机器，把卡插进去，却看到提示：“故障停用。”

ex.s: I jumped out of the car, made a mad run for the machine, and popped my card in, only to read the message: "Out of order.
ex.t: 我跳下车，拼命跑向机器，把卡插进去，却看到提示：“故障停用。”

ex.s: Behind the simple style, however, is a serious message ___46___ (intend) for everyone.
ex.t: 然而，在简洁的风格背后，是一个（第46空，intend）给每个人的严肃讯息。

ex.s: What message does the author most likely want to convey?
ex.t: 作者最可能想传达什么信息？

ex.s: What message does Tara's story convey?
ex.t: 塔拉的故事传达了什么信息？

ex.s: They promote the Olympic values, spreading the message of sport for good.
ex.t: 他们推广奥林匹克价值观，传播"体育向善"的信息。

ex.s: Spreading the message of sport for good.
ex.t: 传播体育向善的信息。

ex.s: There are alternatives to constant written communication, such as leaving voice messages or having a group chat.
ex.t: 除了持续的文字交流，还有别的选择，比如留语音消息或建群聊。

ex.s: What message does the author seem to convey in the text?
ex.t: 作者在文中似乎传达了什么信息？

ex.s: The author agrees with the message of the poem.
ex.t: 作者同意这首诗传达的信息。

ex.s: In fact, most people only absorb about 20 percent of a speaker’s message.
ex.t: 事实上，大多数人只吸收了演讲者信息的约20%。

ex.s: In Asia, messaging platforms are growing rapidly, with users in the hundreds of millions, both at work and play. ___36___.
ex.t: 在亚洲，即时通讯平台正在快速增长，用户数以亿计，无论是在工作中还是娱乐中。___36___。

ex.s: Message with emojis feel more conversational
ex.t: 带表情符号的信息感觉更像对话

ex.s: They make great gifs and you see them many times ___65___ (decorate) with red envelopes and messages of good fortune.
ex.t: 它们是很棒的礼物，你经常看到它们被___65___（装饰）着红包和祝福语。

ex.s: What message does the story convey? （    ）
ex.t: 这个故事传达了什么信息？（    ）

ex.s: He was just saying: “I’m king of this forest, and here is your reminder!” Once his message was delivered, he allowed me    70    (stay) and watch.
ex.t: 它只是在说："我是这片森林之王，这是提醒你！"一旦传达完信息，它允许我____70____（stay）留下观察。

ex.s: Maybe the first plant just made a cry of pain or was sending a message to its own branches, and so, in effect, was talking to itself.
ex.t: 也许第一株植物只是发出了一声痛苦的呐喊，或者是在向自己的枝干传递信息，因此实际上是在跟自己说话。

ex.s: Maybe the first plant just made a cry of pain or was sending a message to its own branches, and so, in effect, was talking to itself.
ex.t: 也许第一株植物只是发出了一声痛苦的呐喊，或者是在向自己的枝干传递信息，因此实际上是在跟自己说话。

ex.s: She hoped to  44   her message of hope and awareness.
ex.t: 她希望有44条希望和认识的信息。

ex.s: The first magazine with your gift message will arrive in time for the special day.
ex.t: 带有你的赠言的第一期杂志将及时送达，赶上那个特殊的日子。

ex.s: They have just received a message from one of our spaceships.
ex.t: 他们刚刚从我们的一艘宇宙飞船收到了一条信息。

ex.s: Jackson Brown Jr Quotes a b c d e Meanings What is the main message of the quote?
ex.t: 小杰克逊\u00b7布朗 名言 a b c d e 含义 这句名言的主要信息是什么？

ex.s: Messages Max Details HBD!(emojis 1) Won’t tell ppl how old U R!
ex.t: 信息 麦克斯 详情 HBD！（表情1）不会告诉别人你多大了！

ex.s: Keeping your message simple and clear will make it easier for people to understand. ___38___ However, they’re hearing it for the first time.
ex.t: 保持信息简单清晰会让人们更容易理解。___38___然而，他们是第一次听到这些信息。

ex.s: One of the most common mistakes in communication is trying to do too much. ___36___ There’s no value in delivering any kind of communication, whether written, spoken, formal, or informal, if the message doesn’t come across clearly.
ex.t: 沟通中最常见的错误之一就是试图做太多。___36___传递任何形式的沟通——无论是书面的、口头的、正式的还是非正式的——如果信息不能被清楚地理解，就没有价值。

defs.def: a piece of information sent in electronic form, for example by email or mobile/cell phone 电邮信息；（手机）短信息

ex.s: When most of us get a text message on our cell phone from an unknown person, we usually say “sorry,    41    number!” and move on.
ex.t: 当我们大多数人在手机上收到陌生人的短信时，通常会说“抱歉，____41____号码！”然后继续。

ex.s: Without our phones, we had a proper conversation for over two hours, without being distracted by messages from other people.
ex.t: 没有了手机，我们进行了一次真正意义上的谈话，持续了两个多小时，没有被别人的信息所打扰。

defs.def: an important moral, social or political idea that a book, speech, etc. is trying to communicate （书、演讲等的）要旨，要点，教训
a piece of information that is sent from the brain to a part of the body, or from a part of the body to the brain （从大脑发给身体某部位或身体某部位向大脑发送的）信息

ex.s: Morse invented a code for sending messages over an electromagnetic circuit.
ex.t: Morse发明了一种通过电磁电路发送信息的编码。

ex.s: Fables can be found all over the world, part of their appeal being how they add humour to a more serious message.
ex.t: 寓言可以在世界各地找到，他们的吸引力之一是他们如何为更严肃的信息增添幽默感。
